android.sourceEquivalence: The Android product and focal test blobs are unchanged between the execution SHA and the final Product SHA.

ios.sourceEquivalence: The complete focal Swift XCTest blob is identical on the execution SHA and final Product SHA; the only later source delta is its static contract.

proves: The common Feed pager crosses 50, 50 and 1 item pages, preserves loaded content after an older-page failure, retries the same cursor explicitly and reaches 101 unique posts.
Android and iOS exercise the product Feed host through visible older-page failure, explicit retry and the exact deep target while retaining the first page.
The iOS gesture is normalized within the semantic feed.root element and does not use a screen-fixed coordinate.
doesNotProve: Native E2E of the separate Feed Ranking panel or unrelated media, detail, comments, profiles and mutations.
A production backend mutation or remote data deployment.
A global visual or operational acceptance of SCR-FEED.

notes: Failed iOS pilots remain as unversioned local diagnostics. They distinguished an unexpanded or non-scrolling accessibility target from product failure and are not counted as positive evidence.
Platform evidence was not repeated solely for amended commit identity. Source-blob equivalence binds the accepted runs to the final Product SHA.
